mission.title: crossplane: Garbage collect unused CompositionRevisions
mission.description: Crossplane never deletes old CompositionRevisions: every Composition update appends a new revision, so `kubectl get compositionrevision | wc -l` grows unbounded (users reported counts climbing from 1415 to 10135), bloating etcd and slowing API listings.

steps.title: Measure CompositionRevision accumulation
steps.description:
Confirm the symptom — an ever-growing number of revisions:
```bash
kubectl get compositionrevision | wc -l
kubectl get compositionrevisions -o jsonpath='{range .items[*].spec.compositeTypeRef}{.kind}{"\n"}{end}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
```
If the count keeps rising after each Composition update and old revisions are never removed, this mission applies. Affected environments have reported 1415 → 10135 revisions.

steps.title: Identify revisions still referenced by composite resources
steps.description:
Only revisions pinned by a composite's `spec.crossplane.compositionRevisionRef` (or the latest revision per Composition) are in use. For each composite type, find the latest revision:
```bash
kubectl get compositionrevision --sort-by='{.spec.revision}' -l crossplane.io/composition-name=<composition-name>
```
The highest `.spec.revision` per Composition is the live one; earlier revisions with no composite referencing them are garbage.

steps.title: Upgrade to a Crossplane release with CompositionRevision garbage collection
steps.description:
crossplane/crossplane#6195 adds automatic garbage collection of unused CompositionRevisions. Upgrade the core Helm release:
```bash
helm repo update
helm upgrade crossplane crossplane-stable/crossplane -n crossplane-system --version <release-with-fix>
```
After the upgrade, the Composition controller prunes revisions that are neither the latest for their Composition nor referenced by any composite resource.

steps.title: Clean up pre-existing unused revisions on older versions
steps.description:
On versions without the fix, delete unreferenced revisions with the community cleanup function (see codeSnippets): it walks each composite type, keeps the latest revision plus any revision still referenced by a composite's `spec.crossplane.compositionRevisionRef`, and deletes the rest:
```bash
k8s-remove-unused-composition-revisions
```
Always verify the kubectl context prompt before confirming.

steps.title: Verify the revision count stays bounded
steps.description:
Re-check after a few Composition updates:
```bash
kubectl get compositionrevision | wc -l
kubectl get events -n crossplane-system --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
The count should now track the number of Compositions (plus any revisions pinned by composites), not grow monotonically.

resolution.summary: Old CompositionRevisions accumulated because Crossplane created a new revision on every Composition change but shipped no garbage collector for superseded ones — the root cause was a missing deletion path, not a misconfiguration. crossplane/crossplane#6195 resolves crossplane/crossplane#4837 by pruning revisions that are not the latest for their Composition and are not referenced by any composite resource's compositionRevisionRef, so etcd usage and list latency stay bounded. On older releases, the cleanup script below removes unused revisions safely because it preserves the latest and any still-referenced revision per composite type.
codeSnippets:
# Symptom: unbounded growth across Composition updates
kubectl get compositionrevision | wc -l   # e.g. 1415 ... later 10135

function k8s-remove-unused-composition-revisions() {
  _CONTEXT="$(kubectl config current-context)"
  echo "Running against context: ${_CONTEXT}"
  read -p "is this correct? (Y/n): " line
  if [ -z "$line" -o "$line" = "Y" -o "$line" = "y" ]; then
    types=$(kubectl get compositionrevisions -o jsonpath='{range .items[*].spec.compositeTypeRef}{.kind}{"\n"}{end}' | sort -u)
    for type in ${types}; do
      echo "Removing unused compositionrevisions for ${type}"
      latest=$(kubectl get compositionrevision --sort-by='{.spec.revision}' | grep ${type} | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}')
      echo "   (latest revision is ${latest})"
      referenced=$(kubectl get ${type} -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.crossplane.compositionRevisionRef.name}{"\n"}{end}' | sort -u)
      for revision in $(kubectl get compositionrevisions | grep ${type} | awk '{print $1}'); do
        if [ "${revision}" != "${latest}" ] && ! echo "${referenced}" | grep -qx "${revision}"; then
          kubectl delete compositionrevision "${revision}"
        fi
      done
    done
  fi
}

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with crossplane installed or the issue environment reproducible.
